name: windows-setup-bar
description: A simple bar for windows setup

scripts.restart: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Stop-Process -Name zebar -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\glzr.io\Zebar\zebar.exe' -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput \"$env:TEMP\zebar-stdout.log\" -RedirectStandardError \"$env:TEMP\zebar-stderr.log\""
scripts.dev:reload: npm run build && npm run restart
